steps.fact: CRM record OAK-77 lists the counterparty name as Oakfield Logistics.
The company rebranded from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH; Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
CRM still shows the old English-facing name for this company.
Registry record HRB 88421 lists the legal name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Billing invoices use the billed name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Because HRB 88421 did not change across the rebrand, Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH denote the same legal entity.
OAK-77's CRM name Oakfield Logistics is the old English-facing name for that same legal entity, so crm:OAK-77 and billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH denote the same counterparty.

support_claim: Commercial notes establish that Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same legal entity via unchanged HRB 88421 and that CRM retains the old English-facing name, linking crm:OAK-77 to the billing name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
